integrity: An all-length combinatorial and probabilistic proof is supplied, with a separate finite exhaustive script checking through length thirteen. Finite experiments are not promoted to infinite proofs. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classified monoid consists only of full order-preserving maps with interval image. The joint probabilistic limit assumes uniform sampling and increasing chain length. Known monoid cardinality and initial-image marginal are cited prior results. Full priority relative to broader transformation-monoid iteration theorems is not established; a related partial-transformation fixed-point paper was accessible only in part.
title: Eventual-image fibers and independent geometric–Gaussian limits in the directed-path weak-endomorphism monoid
